h: Peller plans to name his son with Jarvis after Ronaldo and Messi
p: Streamer Peller has reportedly said he wants to name his unborn son with Jarvis after football stars Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi. He shared the plan during a livestream.
body: Popular streamer Peller has reportedly revealed an unusual plan for the name of his unborn son with his partner, fellow streamer Jarvis.

Peller said during a livestream that he intends to name the baby after two of football's greatest players, Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi. He made the announcement shortly after sharing a gender reveal video showing the couple are expecting a boy.
The choice drew attention because of the long-running rivalry between Ronaldo and Messi.
